release_name: Native Slanted Wall Architecture & Zero-Overlap Multi-Loop Slab Engine
highlights: Native Slanted Wall Integration (WallCrossSection.SingleSlanted): Eliminates stepped traps and horizontal seams on tapering towers, obelisks, and spires with continuous monolithic walls and exact inclination angles (-1.286 deg for 98m obelisk, +60.255 deg for splayed chalices)

Zero-Overlap Multi-Loop Slab Mandate (CurveLoop Donut Loops): Strict prohibition of overlapping solid floors. Slabs must utilize inner void loops (Loop 0 = Outer Boundary CCW, Loop 1..N = Inner Openings CW) ensuring zero Z-fighting, zero spatial clash, and mathematically pure Quantity Takeoff (QTO)
Strategic Architectural Tool Selection Protocol: Lead BIM Engineer must evaluate boundary loops, slanted walls, adaptive components, and massing before executing model geometry
Monas Monument & Merdeka Landscape Reference Implementation: 100% Native BIM, 0 DirectShape, 0 Overlapping Floors verified via in-memory Revit API telemetry
Professional Role Mandate: AIGRAV officially elevated to Senior BIM Engineer & Architect (prohibits blind script execution and unconstructible geometry)

Triple-Layer Independent Validation: Added Layer 3 (Engineering Sanity Gate) auditing structural load paths, continuous column bearings, headroom clearance (min 2.20m), stair ergonomics, weatherproofing/roof slope, and site datum (+0.00 elevation)
Adaptive Component Modeling Engine: Standardized LOD 350-400 parametric component placement via AdaptiveComponentInstanceUtils as the official professional alternative to DirectShape

Milestone-Based Modeling Orchestration Engine: Standardized 4-phase macro-execution (Datum & Structure -> Envelope -> Partitions & Openings -> Rooms & QTO) combining atomic TransactionGroups with visual checkpoint review
fixes: Strictly banned overlapping floor slabs and solid-on-solid geometry in AGENTS.md (Section 1.4 & Section 7)
Resolved stepped traps on Monas obelisk by replacing 5 vertical wall segments with 4 full-height 98m Slanted Walls
Corrected Gross-vs-Net lawn and plaza areas in QTO schedules via multi-loop donut boundary subtractions
Eliminated duplicate NO=25 parameter conflict in Revit sheet documentation
